_notes: Layer-1 suppression registry. Add an entry only after semantic review (Layer 2) and a rationale in LESSONS.md. deadcode uses exact relative paths; duplicates prefers stable cluster id and accepts a legacy path only when every cluster member matches it; hardcoded prefers candidate id and accepts exact (path, pattern) pairs; capabilities keys are 'path:qualname'; forks keys are 'path:qualname::path:qualname' with both sides sorted; contracts keys are channel-specific: cli_without_bootstrap/generation_path_without_env use file paths, defensive_param_loosening and unreferenced_top_level_functions use 'path:lineno', env_written_not_read uses 'path:varname', forwarding_wrappers and same_name_contracts use 'path:lineno:name', experiment_as_library uses the file path. This registry ships empty: every project must build its own suppression list from its own semantic reviews.
